proposals.before: Ministry and board officials were limited to: first, from Reader of the Grand Secretariat through Grand Secretary and above;
proposals.after: Ministry and board officials were limited to: first, from Readers of the Grand Secretariat down through Secretaries of the Grand Secretariat and above;
proposals.reason: Chinese 中書 denotes Grand Secretariat secretaries (zhongshu), not Grand Secretary (大學士); the range is 侍讀學士以下，中書以上.

proposals.before: Ministry and board officials were limited to the following offices: one, from Reader of the Grand Secretariat down through Grand Secretary and above;
proposals.after: Ministry and board officials were limited to the following offices: one, from Readers of the Grand Secretariat down through Secretaries of the Grand Secretariat and above;
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise mistranslates 中書 as Grand Secretary; it should be Secretariat Secretary / zhongshu.

proposals.before: One, princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks of duke and marquis;
proposals.after: One, princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks of prince and duke;
proposals.reason: Chinese 王、公 denotes princes and dukes, not dukes and marquises.

proposals.before: Fixed quotas: sixteen for princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks of duke and marquis, twelve for Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks, fourteen for princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies, six for imperial clan and gioro members, thirty-two for ministry and board officials, ten for eminent scholars, ten for large taxpayers.
proposals.after: Fixed quotas: sixteen for princes of the imperial clan and hereditary noble ranks of prince and duke, twelve for Manchu and Han hereditary noble ranks, fourteen for princes and hereditary noble ranks of the outer dependencies, six for imperial clan and gioro members, thirty-two for ministry and board officials, ten for eminent scholars, ten for large taxpayers.
proposals.reason: Same 王、公 mistranslation as duke and marquis; should be prince and duke.

proposals.before: The winning threshold was half the quotient of district quota divided by total electors.
proposals.after: The winning threshold was half the quotient of total electors divided by the district winner quota.
proposals.reason: Chinese 以本區應出當選人額數除選舉人總數 means divide total electors by the district winner quota; the idiomatic English reverses the dividend and divisor.

proposals.before: Dividing the district's quota of winners by the total number of electors and taking half the quotient gave the winning vote threshold.
proposals.after: Dividing the total number of electors by the district's quota of winners and taking half the quotient gave the winning vote threshold.
proposals.reason: Same inverted division as the idiomatic field: classical/modern 以A除B here yields electors÷quota, not quota÷electors.

proposals.before: Appeals from primary judgments went to the surveillance commissioner; appeals from indirect judgments went to the Board of Punishments.
proposals.after: Appeals from primary judgments went to the surveillance commissioner; appeals from indirect judgments went to the Supreme Court (Daliyuan).
proposals.reason: 大理院 in late Qing is the Supreme Court / Court of Cassation, not the Board of Punishments (刑部).

proposals.before: Those dissatisfied with judgments: primary cases might appeal to the provincial surveillance commissioner; indirect cases might appeal to the Board of Punishments.
proposals.after: Those dissatisfied with judgments: primary cases might appeal to the provincial surveillance commissioner; indirect cases might appeal to the Supreme Court (Daliyuan).
proposals.reason: 大理院 is mistranslated as Board of Punishments; it denotes the late-Qing Supreme Court.

proposals.before: The regent prince acting as regent attended in the sovereign's place, issued an instruction commending and encouraging the members.
proposals.after: The Prince Regent attended in the sovereign's place and issued an instruction commending and encouraging the members.
proposals.reason: 監國攝政王代行蒞選 means the Prince Regent attended on the sovereign's behalf; 'regent prince acting as regent' redundantly mistranslates 代行/攝政 and obscures the sense.

decisions.reason: 內閣侍讀學士以下，中書以上 sets the band from Grand Secretariat Readers down to 中書 (內閣中書). Grand Secretary is 大學士, not 中書; the proposal restores the correct office and keeps the X以下…Y以上 range.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 內閣侍讀學士以下，中書以上

decisions.reason: The literal likewise renders 中書 as Grand Secretary; Secretaries of the Grand Secretariat matches Qing 內閣中書, and the rest already tracks 以下…以上.
宗室王、公世爵 is wang and gong (prince and duke). Duke and marquis would be 公、侯; the idiomatic already has prince and duke, so the literal must match.
定額 repeats 宗室王、公世爵; duke and marquis is the same 王、公 error as in s0074, and prince and duke aligns with the Chinese and with the idiomatic quotas line.

以本區應出當選人額數除選舉人總數 uses the winner quota as divisor of the elector total (electors÷quota); the prior idiomatic inverted dividend and divisor, and the proposed half-quotient threshold restores that arithmetic.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以本區應出當選人額數除選舉人總數，所得半數

decisions.reason: The literal has the same inverted division; 以A除B here is electors divided by the district winner quota, then halved for 當選票額.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以本區應出當選人額數除選舉人總數

decisions.reason: 複選得向大理院上控 names the late-Qing 大理院 (Supreme Court), not 刑部 / Board of Punishments; the proposal corrects only that institution.
The literal likewise substitutes Board of Punishments for 大理院; Supreme Court (Daliyuan) is the accurate late-Qing rendering, with the rest of the appeal path unchanged.

監國攝政王 is the title Prince Regent; 代行蒞選 means he attended in the sovereign's place. 'Regent prince acting as regent' is redundant and obscure; the proposed literal matches the idiomatic and the Chinese.
